findings.issue: `exists_openAddSubgroup_mul_subset` and `exists_openAddSubgroup_forall_mul_subset` (line 309) mention no weight, no `T`, no `MvPowerSeries` and no Huber theory — they are generic facts about `NonarchimedeanRing A` (a fixed element absorbs some open subgroup into any zero-neighbourhood subgroup, and its finite-family form).
